text:
maria: deploy-bot just rejected the publish for release/2026.03.20

deploy-bot: publish blocked - provenance check failed for image redwood/runtime:2026.03.20 (missing attestation for platform linux/arm64) :warning:
error: provenance.attestation.missing(platform=linux/arm64)

raj: i've checked registry - amd64 manifest present + attestation. arm64 manifest exists but cosign attestation not attached. looks like signing step failed on arm builder.

kim: can we fallback to an amd64-only image for the release and note it in the release notes? customers relying on arm might break though. what's our risk tolerance during change window? :thinking:

oliver: two quick options: 1) pin deployment to the previous multi-arch digest (safe, rollback-like), 2) publish amd64-only tag and proceed (less safe for arm users). third option rebuild & re-sign arm which may take ~45-60m.

jen-qa: QA can't validate arm canary without the attestation in registry (our infra prevents unsigned manifests from being promoted). we need either a re-sign or a manual override for canary only. prefer rebuild+sign.

maria: timeline: we have a 23:00 UTC change window. if we rebuild+sign now we could make that. if not, we should pin to previous digest and cut a patch release with arm fixed later.

raj: if we pin, suggested steps:
```
# get previous digest
crane digest gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026.03.19
# pin tag to digest
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcdef1234567890 gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026.03.20-pinned
# update deploybot manifest route to use :2026.03.20-pinned
```
This keeps content identical to what production has today.

oliver: alternative quick publish (if we choose amd64-only):
```
# create manifest list containing only amd64
manifest-tool push from-spec amd64-only-manifest.json
# or retag existing amd64 image
gcloud container images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026.03.20-amd64 gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026.03.20
```
Note: this will make the tag not multi-arch and might break some edge deployments.

kim: release notes update proposal (short):
- Release 2026.03.20: core runtime improvements
- NOTE: temporary amd64-only artifact due to missing arm64 provenance; arm64 build will be published in follow-up patch.
Please add owner/caveats.

jen-qa: i can sign off on amd64-only if product ok with degradation for arm customers and we schedule a follow-up. otherwise i hold until rebuild signed.

maria: product says: acceptable to ship amd64-only for this minor release, but must flag in release notes and support bulletin. we need a clear rollback plan if high-severity errors reported.

raj: operational plan i'm going to run if we proceed with pin: 1) pin tag to previous multi-arch digest, 2) create release branch + publish patched release notes, 3) schedule rebuild job for arm with high priority and cosign upload, 4) once arm attestation present, we can republish a true multi-arch tag and retire pinned tag. I'll open the PR and the ticket.

maria: okay, plan accepted. raj please also add a canary that routes 10% traffic to pinned digest for 30m before full cutover. add smoke checks for text-generation and embeddings routes. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: action queued: update tag mapping for release/2026.03.20 -> gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcdef1234567890 (pinned) ; canary 10% -> pinned for 30m.

oliver: leaving a quick note for oncall: rollback steps if we see regressions:
1) revert deploybot tag mapping to previous stable digest
2) isolate problematic endpoints via routing rules
3) roll forward arm rebuild when available

kim: i'll update release notes and publish the support bulletin now. jen-qa pls sign off on canary results once triggered.

jen-qa: will monitor. setting up canary dashboards and alert thresholds. :eyes:

maria: thanks team. once pj is opened, drop the PR link here and I'll do the final approve.

raj: PR: https://github.com/redwood/release/compare/pin-2026.03.20 (wip)

maria: :thumbsup:
